note: The A tier and the B tier of one family share this contract, so their goldens and case generators stay interchangeable.
input: x of shape (B, S, C), not pre-split Q/K/V
projections: one fused in-projection to 3C, split into q/k/v; the reference defines an out-projection but never applies it, so the output keeps the head layout
mask: causal, top-left, applied before the activation
activation: ReLU on the masked scores, in place of Softmax
normalisation: none: there is no denominator, so the output is a plain weighted sum
causal_mask_buffer: the reference precomputes a (max_seqlen, max_seqlen) tril buffer; input length equals max_seqlen in every case

abi.note: runner is a ModelNew module evaluated in the same process as the reference

window.left: -1: this family applies no window, so every key is visible on the left
window.right: -1: this family applies no window, so every key is visible on the right

fully_masked_row.note: Cannot occur here: with no explicit mask and no padding, every query row sees the whole key range, so the softmax denominator is at least one element. The convention is declared anyway, because §4.2 asks for it and because a reader cannot tell an unreachable case from an unconsidered one.

attention.note: No softmax in this family: the masked scores are rectified and multiplied by v, so there is no denominator to shift and §4.2's max-shift clause does not apply.
